apps.name: HasuBackup
apps.desc: Backup — save any installed app as an APK into Download/HasuBackup, back up everything at once, or share an APK.
apps.changes: A full re-check release. You can now add your own icon set from a file — it is checked, then joins the same picker as yours — and every icon of the set in use is listed in Settings with its name and job. The feed status now shows how much space the packs take on the phone, a Sound & vibration row opens the exact system page, the Guide shows the four launcher designs as pictures, the app's own settings now ride with Android's app backup, and the update page no longer claims an update is "settling" when you are simply up to date.

apps.name: HasuBattery
apps.desc: Battery level, live power details, charge history graph and a full-charge alarm.
apps.changes: A full re-check release. The family's own HasuOS icon set now leads the picker, you can add your own icon set from a file, and every icon of the set in use is listed in Settings with its name and job. The three extra launcher designs were redrawn as real drawings — Bars, Orbit and Pulse — white glyphs on a fully transparent background, each genuinely different (the old three were copies of the Original). The About page now shows the launcher design you actually picked, with the HasuOS brand mark in its own small row. Updates and icon packs are also checked in the background while the app is closed, the update page no longer claims an update is "settling" when you are simply up to date, a failed check says so honestly, quiet hours and a Sound & vibration row join Settings, a Reset card arrives, and the app's own settings now ride with Android's app backup. The charging notification, its live countdown and the voice alerts are untouched.

apps.name: HasuBoard
apps.desc: The HasuOS keyboard — liquid glass, skins & fonts, GIFs, clipboard, a private vault and Bangla phonetic typing.
apps.changes: App icons redrawn your way — white glyphs, no backgrounds, four genuinely different designs (Keys, Outline, Bubble, Stack) — and the first screen carries the HasuBoard logo and name again. The clipboard and logins locks are fixed: no silent opening, no dead ends — unlock with your fingerprint or through the app. Updates and new content now check in the background, hold quietly at night, and the update page is honest about checks and settling. Plus: bring your own icon sets, a Reset for settings, and a Guide with real icon pictures.

apps.name: HasuBrowser
apps.desc: Browser — light and fast browsing with bookmarks, history, downloads and desktop mode.
apps.changes: HasuBrowser grows the full family system: it now updates itself (its own update page, verified downloads with pause and resume), has a Settings page with themes and one icon picker for the whole app — the family's own HasuOS set first — and four launcher designs drawn your way: white glyphs, no backgrounds (Original, Orbit, Compass, Window). Icon packs arrive by themselves from the feed, checks run in the background every ~12 hours and hold quietly at night, the Permissions hub shows the new Notifications and Install updates rows with their real states, and the speed-dial page carries the app's real icon and name.

apps.name: HasuCalc
apps.desc: Calculator — fast glass calculator with history plus a unit converter for length, weight, temperature, area, speed, data, volume and time.
apps.changes: Maths display fixed: 10÷4 now reads 2.5 (was 2.500000000), chained sums keep full precision (1÷3 then ×3 = exactly 1), dividing by 0 says "Can't divide by 0" and keeps your sum. Memory keys MC MR M+ M- added. New Settings page with 6 themes, icon sets (the HasuOS set first — new packs arrive by themselves), 4 white-on-transparent launcher designs, quiet hours and a Reset card. The app now updates itself inside the app with verified, resumable downloads. About shows the app's own icon and carries the new HasuOS brand logo. Full audit: 201 commands checked.

apps.name: HasuCalendar
apps.desc: Calendar — month view with events, times and reminder notifications. Private, no account needed.
apps.changes: Routine updated: daytime = job study, night = varsity study

apps.name: HasuCam
apps.desc: Capture Beyond Limits — pro camera with LMC XML configs, Lib Patcher, AI scene, HDR & Night merge, 20 modes.
apps.changes: Options sheet fixed — the blank first row is now one labelled Flash row showing the live state (Auto / Torch on / Off), and the duplicate hidden torch control is gone: one flash control only · NEW: Permissions section in Settings — Camera, Microphone, Location, Notifications and Photos & videos rows show the real on/off state and act on tap (request on the spot, or the system page when permanently denied) · Full audit pass: everything else verified as-is.

apps.name: HasuClean
apps.desc: Storage cleaner — find the largest files, duplicate photos and junk folders, and free space safely.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until every permission is really on, blue only then, repainted on every return. FIXED: a delete that fails to start no longer leaves "Finish the delete that's waiting first" blocking every later delete until you restart the app. NEW (from 1.06, never published): the duplicate finder now covers videos too — the same size + full-file hash grouping that caught duplicate photos now checks your 2,000 most recent videos as well, so a re-saved video is caught just like a photo; the card is now "Duplicate photos & videos". FIXED (from 1.06): starting a second delete while Android's delete confirmation for the first one is still waiting no longer overwrites the pending callback. FIXED (from 1.05): rotating the phone no longer restarts the whole scan — your junk selection stays put. FIXED (from 1.04): the top of the main screen and the About page now sit properly below the status bar; deleting a large file now asks first in a glass confirm; a rescan can no longer let an old duplicate-thumbnail thread drop its picture onto a row that no longer exists.

apps.name: HasuClock
apps.desc: Clock — alarms with repeat days and snooze, stopwatch with laps, a timer that rings from the background, and world clocks.
apps.changes: NEW: four alarm tones recorded from real life — 🌊 Ocean Waves, 🌧 Gentle Rain, 🐦 Dawn Birds and 🏞 Forest Stream (CC0 recordings, built into the app) — the built-in set is now 14 tones, and the timer can use them too. Each is a 30-second level-normalised loop with a gentle fade, so it rings smoothly until you stop it. The Guide and About pages list them.

apps.name: HasuDice
apps.desc: Dice roller and coin flip — roll 1 to 4 dice with a shuffle animation and a running total, flip a coin with heads and tails tallies, and keep your last rolls on screen.
apps.changes: NEW: ⭐ Saved rolls — save a roll you use a lot under a name (up to 6); tap it to load that exact setup — dice, die type, modifier and Advantage — and roll it at once, and long-press one to delete it. NEW: the range line now shows your roll in dice notation too, like 2d6+3 or D20 · Advantage, so the setup is clear at a glance. FIXED: the six die-type chips now sit a little closer together, so the row always fits on a narrow phone.

apps.name: HasuFiles
apps.desc: File manager — browse all storage, categories for images, videos, music, documents & APKs, search, copy/move, zip & extract.
apps.changes: NEW: 📱 Apps — every installed app on the phone, with its version and APK size — your own apps first, system apps hidden until you tap “System apps”; tap an app to open it, see its App info, back up its APK to Downloads, or uninstall it (system apps cannot be uninstalled). FIXED: moving a file into the folder it is already in leaves it alone now, instead of renaming it to “Name (1)”. FIXED: the ＋ New folder button only shows while you are inside a folder — in a category or a search it used to sit there and do nothing. FIXED: Recent, Large files, Duplicates and Junk now say so when the scan stops early, instead of silently missing folders past the cap. The Guide and About pages list all four.

apps.name: HasuGameBox
apps.desc: Six games in one box — Tic Tac Toe against the computer, classic Snake, Memory Match, 2048, Tap Rush and Minesweeper. Best scores are kept for every game, all offline.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every game and button, explained one by one. NEW: a sixth game — Minesweeper: an 8×8 field with 10 mines, tap to clear, long-press to flag, your first tap can never be a mine, and your best clear time is kept on the hub. NEW: every game now buzzes — a tap, a match, a merge, a mine all feel different. FIXED: the Minesweeper clock now counts for real — it used to sit at 0s, so every win recorded a best time of 0s and the hub never showed one; the clock runs from a start timestamp and freezes when you leave. FIXED: rotating the phone no longer loses your game — all six games pick up where you left off.

apps.name: HasuHabit
apps.desc: Habit tracker — build good habits with streaks, week dots and monthly completion. Tap to mark each day done.
apps.changes: Routine updated: daytime = job study, night = varsity study

apps.name: HasuHealth
apps.desc: Health — step counter with 7-day history, daily water tracker with a goal, and a BMI calculator. All on your phone.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until every permission is really on, blue only then, repainted on every return (the drawable was always blue). FIXED: tapping the Notifications row now opens the notification settings when the permission is already granted but the system switch is off — before, the row still read ON while no water reminder could ever show. FIXED: '✅ Turn all on' no longer claims 'All permissions are on' when exact alarms are off or the notification switch is off — it opens the right settings page instead, and only says all are on when everything really is. FIXED: the day's steps, water and weight now roll over at Dhaka midnight even if the phone is set to another timezone — the date was formatted in the phone's own timezone before. The Guide and About pages list all five.

apps.name: HasuKhata
apps.desc: Daily hisab in taka: month summary, categories and day-by-day entries.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: tap the month name to jump straight back to this month, however far you have flipped away with ‹ ›. The Guide and About pages list both.

apps.name: HasuLock
apps.desc: App lock — protect any app with a PIN pad and fingerprint unlock.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: the lock pad now sits below the real status bar on every phone — it used a fixed 56 dp top gap before. FIXED: the app picker opens at once — app icons now load in the background instead of freezing the screen while every icon is read. DESIGN: the app icon on the About page now sits on a glass tile, like the main screen.

apps.name: HasuMusic
apps.desc: Music player — songs, albums and artists from your library, background playback with notification controls, shuffle and repeat.
apps.changes: NEW: long-press a song in Up next to take it out of the queue — the song playing now stays put, and the rest of the queue closes ranks around it. FIXED: the sleep timer now stops the music completely — when the time runs out the notification clears too, instead of leaving the player running in the background with nothing playing. FIXED: stopping the music from the notification also cancels a running sleep timer, so it can no longer bring the notification back after you stopped it. FIXED: the song playing now stays highlighted in the library even when you are inside an open album or artist. FIXED: the audio focus is handed back cleanly between songs instead of leaving old listeners behind. The Guide and About pages list all five.

apps.name: HasuNamaz
apps.desc: Prayer times for Bangladesh — offline calculation, next-waqt countdown, Qibla compass and per-waqt alarms.
apps.changes: NEW: 🕌 The recorded azan is now bundled in the app — at each waqt the alarm plays the real azan recording (the one you provided) on the alarm channel, repeating until you tap Stop (or five minutes), with the same full-screen alarm page over the lock screen. Location-true prayer times from 1.06 stay exactly as they were.

apps.name: HasuNews
apps.desc: Bangla news — Prothom Alo and BBC Bangla headlines, articles open inside the app, and last headlines stay saved for offline reading.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: Atom feeds now work — the parser only understood RSS <item> entries with the link as text, so a custom Atom feed (articles in <entry>, links as <link href="…"/> attributes, dates in <updated>) loaded zero articles and looked empty. All three are read now. FIXED: removing a custom feed while its headlines are still loading no longer crashes the app — the stale load is dropped instead of reaching for the feed that is gone. FIXED: rotation no longer rebuilds any screen — every screen now keeps its state across a turn. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list them all.

apps.name: HasuNotes
apps.desc: Notes — quick private notes with pinning, colours and search. Auto-saves, no account, everything stays on your phone.
apps.changes: NEW: ↙ Import — bring notes back from a text file you choose. A file HasuNotes exported splits back into its separate notes, with their titles, pins and checklist marks intact; any other text file becomes one note. NEW: 🎨 Colour filter — tap a colour dot beside Sort to show only notes of that colour; tap it again, or the empty circle, to show them all — the choice sticks. FIXED: the About page’s last highlights no longer run together on one line — the Export and search lines were joined by a broken line-break, so they showed as one long row. NEW: the editor header now says when the note was last edited. The Guide and About pages list all four.

apps.name: HasuOS Home
apps.desc: Your home screen, HasuOS style — a liquid-glass launcher with widgets, an App Library, lock screen and themes.
apps.changes: ICON PACKS WORK NOW. Applying a pack from HasuPack while Home is running really changes the icons — before, the running launcher dropped the signal and nothing happened, even though it said the pack was set. Now the pack applies at once, the confirmation appears only after the icons have really changed, and if a pack cannot be read the app says so honestly instead of pretending.

apps.name: HasuPDF
apps.desc: PDF tools — photos to PDF, merge PDFs and split out pages, saved to Download/HasuPDF.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. NEW: open PDFs from other apps — tap a PDF in Files, a chat or an email and choose HasuPDF to read it right here, with no copy made. NEW: ↗ Share in the viewer — share the PDF you are reading from the top of the reader, and the viewer remembers the last page you read in each PDF. NEW: viewer zoom — the 🔍 button cycles 1×, 1.5×, 2×, re-rendering the page sharper at each step, and the page scrolls sideways when zoomed; the zoom level survives rotation along with the page. FIXED: rotation no longer rebuilds any screen. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list them all.

apps.name: HasuQuick
apps.desc: A floating assistive ball — favourite apps and quick actions (home, torch, lock, screenshot) anywhere.
apps.changes: BALL CONTROL FIX. If you grab the ball again while it is still gliding to the edge, the glide now stops instantly and the ball follows your finger — before, the glide and your drag fought over the ball and it could jump. Everything else stays as it was: your chosen ball face, size, fade and snap behaviour are untouched.

apps.name: HasuRadio
apps.desc: Live radio — Radio Foorti, Bangladesh Betar, Jago FM, Peoples Radio, Radio Today and BBC World Service, with favourites and background playback.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one (the user order 2026-11-20 ~05:33; HasuRadio never had one). FIXED: a phone call, a voice message or any short sound no longer stops the radio for good — it pauses, then starts again by itself when the sound ends, and a sound that plays over the radio only turns it down for a moment; a call that takes the sound for good still leaves it paused. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until notifications are really allowed, blue only then, repainted on every return (the same bug fixed in Clock 1.15 / Speed 02.10 / Assist 1.02 / Battery 1.07 / Vault 1.05 / Backup 1.06 / Scan 1.06; the drawable was always blue). DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. FOLDED IN (never published before): staged 1.04 — rotation no longer rebuilds any screen, so playback and the sleep timer keep running through a turn. FOLDED IN: staged 1.03 — 🕐 Recently played, your last five stations one tap to resume; the playback notification carries HasuRadio’s own icon; a ✕ button on the station search clears it in one tap.

apps.name: HasuScan
apps.desc: QR & barcode scanner with torch and gallery scan — plus a QR maker for text, links, Wi-Fi and more.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one (the user order 2026-11-20 ~05:33; HasuScan never had one). NEW: 👁 Hidden network — making a Wi-Fi QR can now say the network is hidden, so a phone knows it does not broadcast its name. FIXED: the About page's top bar now clears the status bar on every phone (it used a fixed 20 dp); the app icon there sits on a glass tile now. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until the camera is really granted, blue only then, repainted on every return (the same bug fixed in Clock 1.15 / Speed 02.10; the drawable was always blue). NEW (from staged 1.05): Email QR codes — a sixth QR type with an optional subject, and the type chips now sit in two rows of three so the sixth is never clipped. FIXED (from staged 1.05): rotation no longer rebuilds any screen — every screen now keeps its state across a turn. NEW (from staged 1.04): search your history — find any past scan in seconds; the QR picture is recycled after use instead of lingering in memory.

apps.name: HasuShare
apps.desc: Offline file sharing — pick files, share them over WiFi or hotspot, and the other phone downloads them from your browser address. No internet needed.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until notifications are really allowed, blue only then, repainted on every return. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. FIXED: rotation no longer rebuilds any screen — the share address, QR code and download count keep going through a turn instead of the whole screen restarting. The Guide and About pages list them all.

apps.name: HasuShikha
apps.desc: English words — 120 common words with Bangla meanings and examples. Flip the card, mark what you know, review what you missed.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one (the user order 2026-11-20 ~05:33; HasuShikha never had one). FIXED: flipping the quiz direction after answering no longer lets one question score twice — the ⇄ button now waits until the next question. FIXED: the quiz never shows two identical Bangla answers together — five meanings are shared by two words each (আগে, শিশু, পেছনে, পরিষ্কার, প্রত্যেক), so a twin is now skipped when picking the wrong answers. FIXED: Reset all progress no longer wipes your quiz best score — only the Know / Don’t know marks are cleared, as the confirm says. FIXED: tapping Listen twice quickly no longer loses the word — the second tap waits for the speech engine to be ready. DESIGN: the app icon on the About page now sits on a glass tile. FOLDED IN (never published before): staged 1.05 — the quiz now runs both ways, and rotation no longer rebuilds any screen.

apps.name: HasuShot
apps.desc: Screenshots & screen recording from a floating button — gallery, crop, edit and recycle bin built in.
apps.changes: NEW: a 🎨 Saturation slider in the editor — drain the colour out for black-and-white, or double it; it sits beside Brightness and Contrast. NEW: six draw colours now — White, Red, Yellow, Green, Blue and Black. FIXED: the recycle bin now reuses its thumbnails — opening it again no longer reloads every picture from disk. FIXED: the crop screen's buttons now sit clear of the gesture bar at the bottom. FIXED: a screenshot taken during the 3-2-1 countdown no longer brings the floating button back on screen before the recording starts. The Guide and About pages list all five.

apps.name: HasuSpeed
apps.desc: Live internet speed in your notification — download & upload now, today's totals and per-app usage.
apps.changes: FIXED: 🔢 The status-bar speed number now stays in its place — it no longer jumps to the front of the icon row every time the speed changes. The number is now its own tiny silent notification that only ever updates in place, and the big detail card is separate: swipe it away and it stays away until you open the app again, while the number keeps updating. Turn the meter off and both go away.

apps.name: HasuStore
apps.desc: Your HasuStore — every HasuOS app, in one place. Online updates included.
apps.changes: THE UPDATE ARROW POINTS THE RIGHT WAY. Everywhere the store shows an update waiting — the home circle, the badge on an app, the version line, Update all, the notification and the Recent page — the arrow is now a download arrow, because an update is something you download. In every built-in icon set too, the update icon is a down arrow now.

apps.name: HasuTasbih
apps.desc: Digital tasbih — a big tap circle for dhikr counting: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar and La ilaha illallah, targets of 33, 99 or 100, rounds and a lifetime total, all remembered.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. NEW: 📅 Today's count — the stats line now shows how many dhikr you have done today, resetting by itself at midnight, while your lifetime total keeps growing. NEW: 🎯 Custom target — tap ＋ beside the targets to count to any number from 10 to 9999; your custom target is remembered as its own chip, and long-press it to clear it. FIXED: Reset and −1 now sit on their own row under the targets, so nothing is squeezed on a narrow phone. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list all five.

apps.name: HasuTask
apps.desc: To-dos — tasks with a date, time and priority, and reminders that fire on time. Filter by Today, All or Done.
apps.changes: Routine updated: daytime = job study, night = varsity study

apps.name: HasuTools
apps.desc: Tools — compass, bubble level, real-size ruler, torch with strobe and SOS, and a sound meter.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every tool and button, explained one by one. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until Camera and Microphone are both really on, blue only then, repainted on every return (the drawable was always blue). FIXED: Strobe and SOS on a phone with no flash no longer repeat the 'No flash on this phone' message — they stop after the first one. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. FOLDED IN (never published before): SOS now flashes true Morse timing — three short, three long, three short — and the Strobe and SOS buttons stay lit while their mode is running; the ruler now measures from the screen's vertical density, so a centimetre on screen is a real centimetre; rotation no longer rebuilds any screen. The Guide and About pages list the Guide and the honest toggle.

apps.name: HasuUsage
apps.desc: Usage — see where your time goes: screen time and data per app for today, yesterday and the last 7 days.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. NEW: search the app list — a search box with a ✕ clear button filters by app name or package, with a match count, while the total card keeps showing the whole period; the search text survives rotation. FIXED: the total screen time now counts every app you opened, even briefly — short visits used to be left out of the total while the 7-day chart still counted them. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until Usage access is really on, blue only then, repainted on every return. FIXED: the 7-day chart days now read Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa — Tuesday and Thursday were both just T before. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile.

apps.name: HasuVault
apps.desc: A private vault for photos, videos & PDFs — AES-256 encryption, PIN and fingerprint lock.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until fingerprint unlock is really on, blue only then, repainted on every return. FIXED: the PIN pad now scrolls on short screens, so every key stays reachable when the phone is turned sideways. FIXED: big photos now open downsampled to your screen in the viewer, so a large photo can no longer run the viewer out of memory.

apps.name: HasuVoice
apps.desc: Voice recorder — one-tap recording with a live level meter, playback, rename and share.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one (the user order 2026-11-20 ~05:33; HasuVoice never had one). FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until the microphone and notifications are really on, blue only then, repainted on every return (the same bug fixed in Clock 1.15 / Speed 02.10 / Assist 1.02 / Battery 1.07 / Vault 1.05 / Backup 1.06 / Usage 1.05; the drawable was always blue). FIXED: long recordings now show hours — a 1-hour-20-minute take used to read as 80:12. FIXED: turning the phone no longer restarts any screen, so a recording, its timer, the player and the list all stay exactly as they were. FIXED: renaming a recording no longer cuts ".m4a" out of the middle of its name — only the trailing extension is stripped. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. FOLDED IN (never published before): staged 1.03 — the "Recording…" notification now carries HasuVoice's own icon instead of a system microphone glyph, and a ✕ button on the recordings search clears it in one tap.

apps.name: HasuWall
apps.desc: Your gallery — photos & videos with editors, live wallpapers, favourites and a recycle bin.
apps.changes: NEW: ✨ Picks — twelve wallpapers built into the app itself (Moraine Lake, Alpenglow Peaks, Aurora Night, Beach Parasols, Foggy Forest, Sunflower Sunset, Deep Nebula, Coral Reef, Cherry Blossom, Autumn Path, Tropical Shore, City Mono), all public-domain / CC0 photographs from Wikimedia Commons, cropped to a full phone screen. Tap ✨ Picks on the bottom bar, tap any one to preview, edit, favourite and set it — no download, no internet, no permission. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until every permission is really on, blue only then, repainted on every return (the drawable was always blue). The Guide and About pages list both.

apps.name: HasuWeather
apps.desc: Weather — current conditions and a 7-day forecast for any city on earth, powered by Open-Meteo.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle at the top is now honest — grey with the knob on the left until Location is really on, blue only then, repainted on every return (the drawable was always blue). FIXED: the place line no longer ends in a dangling comma when My location cannot name the country. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. FOLDED IN (never published before): the staged 1.03 — pressure and visibility cards, a ✕ clear on the search box and Enter searches too, rotation keeps the search text and the forecast, the hourly strip never labels a past hour "Now", and an unparseable sunrise or sunset shows a dash instead of a 24-hour stamp. The Guide and About pages list the Guide and the honest toggle.

apps.name: HasuOS
apps.desc: Every HasuOS app in one place — the whole family with its details, straight from the live catalogue. Tap any app for its story, version and size, and get it through HasuStore.
apps.changes: The About section is now Settings: the ℹ button in the header is now a ⚙ gear, and the page it opens is titled Settings. Everything on the page is exactly as before — same app details, Highlights, Guide and website link.

apps.name: Hasu
apps.desc: Hasu's whole details in one app — a living portfolio: name, role, story, work and contact, all editable on the phone. The developer behind HasuOS.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. FIXED: 📱 Open the HasuOS app now really opens the HasuOS app when it is installed — Android could not see the app from Hasu before, so the button could only ever offer the APK download. DESIGN: the About page icon now sits on a glass tile. The Guide and About pages list the Guide and the HasuOS app fix.

apps.name: HasuTube
apps.desc: YouTube inside its own HasuOS app: home feed, Shorts, subscriptions and library, built-in search and real full-screen video.
apps.changes: FIXED: sharing a video, or opening Guide, About or Permissions while a video plays, no longer shrinks the video into a floating window — only pressing the Home key does that now. NEW: long-press a video or channel title to open its link, copy it, or share it, without opening it first. The Guide and About pages list both.

apps.name: HasuWeb
apps.tag: The HasuOS website, as an app
apps.desc: The HasuOS website inside its own app: the same pages and the same live catalogue, served by the website's own server — every app update shows here the moment it reaches the website.
apps.changes: NEW: 🔰 Text size — pick Small, Normal, Large or Extra large from the ℹ️ menu; the choice is remembered and applies to every page. NEW: 🌐 Open in browser — send the page you're on to your browser in one tap, from the ℹ️ menu. FIXED: Back now closes the Find bar first, before walking the page history, like a browser. The Guide and About pages list all three.

apps.name: HasuMaps
apps.tag: The HasuOS map — the world, in glass
apps.desc: His idea, straight from his message: Google Maps, the HasuOS way. The full OpenStreetMap in one glass window — search any place on Earth, directions for car, bike and foot, and a Locate button that centres the map on you from your phone's GPS. No API key, no Google services: open map data, plus the family Permissions hub and About page.
apps.changes: NEW: 📍 Search by coordinates — paste "23.8103, 90.4125" (or 23°48'37"N 90°24'45"E) into the search bar and the map drops a pin on that exact spot, with its name and address; coordinates work in From / To / Stop too. The Guide and About pages list it.

apps.name: HasuAssist
apps.desc: Your HasuOS chat assistant — a real AI chat in glass: questions, study and exam help, writing, translation, maths and ideas, in Bengali, English or any language. Voice typing, chats saved on your phone. Needs the internet; no account, no sign-up.
apps.changes: NEW: 📖 Guide page — tap Guide on the About page for every button and feature, explained one by one. NEW: ↗ Share chat — send the whole conversation as text to any app you choose. NEW: ⏹ Stop — cut a reply off while it is still generating. FIXED: after a failed answer, ↻ Try again asks the same question again — no more retyping it. FIXED: the 🔐 Permissions toggle is honest now — grey until the microphone is really on, blue only then. FIXED: pictures are drawn downsampled to the screen instead of decoding the full picture on every bubble, and pictures from old trimmed chats no longer linger on the phone. The Guide and About pages list all six.

apps.name: Hasu City
apps.tag: Your city. Your streets. Your rules.
apps.desc: A real 3D open-city game, the HasuOS way: a whole 3D city of streets and blocks to explore on foot or in any car you can grab, seen from behind your character like a true third-person game. Living traffic roams the roads, day turns to night and the city lights up, and your character and cash are remembered. The weather lives too: clear spells cloud over, rain sweeps in and storms flash lightning. Jobs, police, shops and a full map arrive stage by stage.
apps.changes: Bug fixes: camera drag now turns the view the same way you drag (drag right goes right, drag left goes left); characters now collide with cars instead of walking straight through them; your partner now runs to the passenger door and gets in properly, instead of standing inside the car with her head over the roof.

apps.name: HasuStudy
apps.desc: Government-job exam practice — 80 BCS-style MCQs in বাংলা, English, গণিত and সাধারণ জ্ঞান, with Practice mode and timed mock tests.
apps.changes: NEW APP: 📚 Government-job exam practice — 80 BCS-style MCQs in বাংলা, English, গণিত and সাধারণ জ্ঞান. 📝 Practice mode shows the right answer and a one-line reason for every question. ⏱ Mock tests: 10 questions against a 5-minute clock, marked at the end with a full review. 📊 Per-subject accuracy and best mock scores are remembered on the phone.

apps.name: HasuQuran
apps.desc: Read the Quran with Bangla translation — all 114 surahs, every ayah in Arabic (Uthmani script) with its translation, bookmarks and offline reading.
apps.changes: NEW APP: 📖 Read the Quran with Bangla translation — all 114 surahs with name, meaning, ayah count and Makkah/Madinah. 🕌 Every ayah in Arabic (Uthmani script) with its Bangla translation under it. 🔍 Search by name, meaning or number. 💾 A surah is fetched once and saved on the phone, so it reads offline after that. 🔖 Bookmarks, 📖 last-read, and a 🔠 large-text switch.

apps.name: HasuTyping
apps.desc: Typing speed practice in English and Bangla — timed tests with live WPM and accuracy, best speeds and a test history.
apps.changes: NEW APP: ⌨️ Typing speed practice in English and বাংলা — six passages in each. ⏱ 1, 2 or 5 minute tests; the clock starts with your first letter. 🟩 Every letter is coloured as you type — green when right, red when wrong — with live WPM and accuracy. 🏆 Best speed kept for each language, and your recent tests are listed with date, time and score.

apps.name: HasuDiary
apps.desc: A private diary behind a 4-digit PIN — dated entries with a mood and a photo, search, and everything kept only on the phone.
apps.changes: NEW APP: 📔 A private diary behind a 🔒 4-digit PIN, asked every time the app opens and stored only as a scrambled hash. Entries carry a date and time, a title, your words, a 😊 mood and one 📷 photo — the photo is copied into the diary so it stays. 🔍 Search, 🔑 change PIN, and everything stays only on this phone.

apps.name: HasuBook
apps.desc: Your own corner of the community — a feed with stories, photo posts, likes, comments, friends and alerts, all on this phone.
apps.changes: NEW APP: HasuBook 1.00 — your own corner of the community. A feed with stories, a composer with photo posts, and likes, comments and share on every post. Friends tab with requests and people you may know, Alerts with 12-hour times, search across posts and people, and your own editable profile. A sample community is bundled so it is alive from the first open; everything lives only on this phone. 📖 Guide page and 🔐 Permissions hub included — no permissions, no account.

apps.name: HasuCommunity
apps.desc: Chats with your people in HasuOS glass — bubbles, photo messages, seen ticks and group chats, all on this phone.
apps.changes: NEW APP: HasuCommunity 1.00 — chats with your people, in HasuOS glass. A chat list with last messages, 12-hour times and unread badges, an active-now row, message bubbles with photo messages, ✓ Delivered and ✓✓ Seen, group chats with named senders, a People tab and search. The bundled sample friends reply on the phone itself; every chat lives only on this device. 📖 Guide page and 🔐 Permissions hub included — no permissions, no account.

apps.name: HasuShorts
apps.desc: Short videos, full screen — a swipe-up feed built from the short clips already on your phone, plus your own uploads.
apps.changes: NEW APP: HasuShorts 1.00 — short videos, full screen. A swipe-up feed built from the short videos (90 seconds or less) already on your phone, plus four bundled sample shorts, with likes and comments saved on the phone, a Discover thumbnail grid, a Liked tab, share, and ➕ to add your own short with a caption at any length. 📖 Guide page and 🔐 Permissions hub included — one permission only: your videos.

apps.name: HasuDown
apps.desc: Every file, downloaded — paste any direct link, pause and resume from the exact byte, finished files in Downloads/HasuDown.
apps.changes: NEW APP: HasuDown 1.00 — a download manager for every file. Paste a link or share one in from any app; up to three downloads run at once with live progress and speed while the rest queue and start by themselves. Pause and resume from the exact byte, even after the app closes, and finished files are saved to Downloads/HasuDown ready to open. 📖 Guide page and 🔐 Permissions hub included — no runtime permissions.

apps.name: HasuSMS
apps.desc: The phone's SMS in HasuOS glass — every conversation, chat bubbles, sending, and a path to becoming the default SMS app.
apps.changes: FIX: HasuSMS now appears in Settings → Default apps → SMS app. The MMS push receiver Android requires for that list was missing (the same kind of bug as HasuPhone's dialer listing) — added, so HasuSMS can now be chosen as the default SMS app. An arriving MMS shows a notification; MMS picture download is not built yet.

apps.name: HasuEdit
apps.desc: Edit photos with filters, drawing and draggable overlays — and videos with one-layer merge, trim and overlays burned into every frame.
apps.changes: 1.02: the video overlay now shows a LIVE PREVIEW — the video's first frame with your text or picture drawn at the exact spot and size that will be burned in, so you see the change before you apply it. The export engine was also fixed: it now waits properly for the encoder to finish (the old code could lose the end of the video) and checks the finished file before calling it saved — an empty result is reported honestly, never saved as a success.

apps.name: HasuPhone
apps.desc: The phone app in HasuOS glass — recent calls, contacts, a dial pad with real tones, and its own call screen as the default phone app.
apps.changes: Call screen fixed: a red ● Recording pill with its own timer shows while recording runs; a − / + volume row with green level bars sets the call volume on screen (the side keys show there too); Speaker turns blue when on and Mute turns orange when muted, so every button shows what it did.

apps.name: HasuCell
apps.desc: Your address book in HasuOS glass: search, favourites, and a page for every person. Connected with HasuPhone — contacts saved here appear there at once, calls open in HasuPhone with the SIM 1 / SIM 2 choice, and HasuPhone's Add/Edit opens this editor.
apps.changes: Categories arrived here too — the same ones as HasuPhone: Family, Father, Mother, Wife, Son, Friends, Business, plus your own. Set a contact's category on their page (the Category row), and filter the list by the chips under the search box. A category set here shows in HasuPhone and HasuSMS too.

apps.name: HasuWallet
apps.tag: Your passwords & cards, in HasuOS glass
apps.desc: A full password vault that lives only on your phone: master password + fingerprint unlock, AES-256 encryption, and — once you make it the default autofill service in its Settings — auto fill and auto save for logins across apps and websites. Cards, notes, favourites, search and a strong-password generator. No account, no cloud, no internet.
apps.changes: THE FILL SWITCH, PROVEN + SELF-UPDATE ARRIVES. The master-password-on-fill switch now does exactly what it says on every surface: ON means HasuWallet asks for the master password before any fill, every time; OFF means it fills automatically. The Permissions page now tells the truth about HasuWallet itself (it carried another app's leftover text — fixed). And HasuWallet can now update itself: its own check, notification, download and install, with an App update card in Settings and an Install updates row in Permissions.

apps.name: HasuPack
apps.desc: Six icon packs drawn for the HasuOS family — Glow, Neon Blue, Royal Gold, Sunset, Mono Tile and Pastel. Tap Set in HasuPack and HasuOS Home wears the pack at once.
apps.changes: Tap any pack and a full page opens: scroll sideways through every icon in the pack, and the Apply button sits at the top-right corner — one tap applies the whole pack. NEW pack: Diamond — a violet diamond tile with a neon edge. 3 more apps drawn: Wikipedia, Google Assistant and Khan Academy (161 apps drawn in every style). More icons keep coming.

apps.name: HasuIsland
apps.tag: The Dynamic Island, as its own app
apps.desc: The Dynamic Island in its own app, connected to HasuOS Home: time, your song with play/pause, charging, incoming calls, timer and stopwatch — floating over every app. Living in its own app, a launcher restart can never take it down.
apps.changes: The icon goes FULL white — a clean white tile with the black island pill, just as you asked.

apps.name: HasuWidget
apps.tag: Every HasuOS Home widget, one tap to add
apps.desc: The widget gallery for HasuOS Home: all 66 widget kinds in one glass list — every row now shows a live preview of the widget itself, plus search, categories and favourites. Tap Add on any widget and it appears on your home screen.
apps.changes: FIXED: every widget preview now shows the widget exactly as it sits on HasuOS Home — same size, same layout, same values (all 66 previews rebuilt from Home's own rendering) — and the Widget ↔ Home connection is fixed end to end: placed widgets report their real sizes, the music widget no longer goes missing from the list, and previews use Home's real grid size. DESIGN: more premium — real Font Awesome glyphs, gradient Add and Apply buttons, glass chips.

apps.name: HasuJobs
apps.desc: Bangladesh government job circulars for Diploma in Computer Science / CSE holders — BPSC, ministries, city corporations and more, every one checked against its official source. New circulars appear in the app by themselves from the live feed, with no app update. Deadline and days-left on every card, Apply opens the official page.
apps.changes: BACKGROUND CHECKS ARE FASTER NOW. The app now checks the feeds by itself every 15 minutes instead of 45 — a new circular, new questions, admit or result news reaches you within about 15 minutes even if you never open the app. Nothing else changes.
